options.name: legend
options.description: Visible legend; the group's accessible name.

options.name: hideLegend
options.description: Visually hide the legend (it stays the accessible name).

options.name: description
options.description: Help text for the group, referenced by aria-describedby.

options.name: required
options.description: Required marker; '(required)' is added to the spoken legend.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Sets the native disabled attribute; unset leaves it alone.

options.name: error
options.description: Group-level error message; empty or null hides it.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the first enabled, visible control in the group (pass as an Error Summary item's focus).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove the legend, help, and error; restore a page legend and aria-describedby.

contentAreas.name: controls
contentAreas.description: The fieldset's own children (any controls); they stay in place after the legend, help, and error.
